description: Header file defining the fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator class, which translates slot-based FAPI messages into PHY-specific data types for upper PHY processing in a 5G NR context. It includes configuration, dependencies, and internal classes for slot management, message handling, and resource management.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator
classes.description: Main class that handles translation of slot-based FAPI messages into PHY data types, manages resources, and handles slot transitions.

classes.name: slot_based_upper_phy_controller
classes.description: Manages PHY resources for a specific slot, following RAII principles.

classes.name: slot_based_upper_phy_controller_manager
classes.description: Manages multiple slot controllers, providing acquisition and release based on slot.

classes.name: pdsch_pdu_repository
classes.description: Stores PDSCH PDUs for processing within a slot.

methods.name: on_last_message
methods.description: Handles the event of the last message in a slot.

methods.name: handle_new_slot
methods.description: Processes transition to a new slot, finalizing previous PDUs and resetting repositories.

methods.name: set_error_indication_notifier
methods.description: Sets the notifier for FAPI error indications.
